## lockstep installs from aes canonical

ID: `lockstep-package/lockstep-installs-from-aes-canonical`

Status: **implemented and tested**

Installing this repository SHALL provide the Python package `lockstep` and the commands `lockstep` and `lockstep-hook`, which run Lockstep's whole-tree check and its agent edit hook.

## the old pcw names keep working

ID: `lockstep-package/the-old-pcw-names-keep-working`

Status: **implemented and tested**

The commands `pcw` and `pcw-hook`, `python -m pcw.<module>` and cog blocks that say `import pcw.cogtext as c` SHALL run the same code as their `lockstep` names, until every user has moved.
